title: The normalized scalar-derived pair with the actual coefficient adjunctions
statement: A specified ordinary extension functor, its sectionwise object and morphism equations, its additive structure, a left-derived functor with counit computing on K-flat complexes, and ordinary and derived adjunctions whose unit square commutes determine a ScalarDerivedPair with exactly those functors and adjunctions. In particular the actual integral-to-finite coefficient extension and recorded derived adjunction form such a pair.

source.place: Tags 03CZ, 07A4 and 07A6; ordinary adjunction units, K-flat derived scalar extension and its normalized derived adjunction.

proof.text: For two adjunctions and a comparison of their right adjoints, apply the derived adjunction bijection to both candidate transposes. Rewrite the bijection with its unit, use naturality, the given unit square, and the ordinary triangle identity. This proves adjunctionTranspose_of_unit.

Build scalarPairWithAdjunction using the given functors, counit and adjunctions. K-flat computation is the supplied counit isomorphism. Its ordinary-unit formula is the supplied section formula. For the normalized transpose square apply the preceding transpose identity to the homotopy adjunction and derived adjunction; identify the homotopy quotient maps and the canonical complex/homotopy localization comparison.

Specialize to the actual integral coefficient projection. The scalar-extension existence theorem supplies the object/morphism equations and normalized ordinary unit, the derived-existence theorem supplies left-derivedness and computation on K-flat complexes, and the recorded derived scalar adjunction supplies the unit square. All object data are the specified functors; no arbitrary witness of mere existence is used.
